notes.ERRATUM (venial) in DMJP Cor 7.3: the text says 'Ker(partial_1) cap Ker(partial_2) = C[x]' for the derivations ON A[w]; but w lies in both kernels, so on A[w] the intersection contains C[x][w]. The classical statement is on A (Makar-Limanov); on A[w] one must adjoin d/dw, which the paper's own framework supplies. Cor 7.3's CONCLUSION is unaffected -- see the repair below.
notes.H15 boundary: dropping partial_red destr: the Cor-7.3 triple alone spans only 3 directions -- x is fixed
notes.no triangular flag through partial_red w: partial_red commutes with none of partial_1, partial_2, d/dw, and the three that do commute have the structurally dead invariant ring C[x] (Lemma L1). No new candidate coordinate system came out of the bracket structure. Stated as a measurement of what these six brackets show, not as a claim that no flag exists.
notes.partial_1(p) and partial_2(p) are not bo: the Cor-7.3 derivations do NOT preserve ker partial pointwise
notes.repair: partial_red(x) != 0, so ML(A[w]): any f(x) in ML would need partial_red(f) = f'(x) partial_red(x) = 0 in a domain, forcing f constant
notes.the four derivations form a GENERIC FRAM: 4x4 determinant in the model is nonzero
notes.{partial_1, partial_2, d/dw} is a commut: so A[w] carries a Ga^3-action -- but its invariant ring is C[x] (DMJP Cor 7.3, repaired below), and our own Lemma L1 (M1-PREREG, frozen d423397) says x can NEVER be a coordinate of A^4, because A[w]/(x) is the NON-NORMAL cusp cylinder. So this flag is structurally dead as a coordinate system -- a banked lemma of ours closing a published structure.

cor_7_3.erratum: as printed the intersection is stated on A[w] but omits w; adjoining d/dw repairs it and the conclusion ML(A[w]) = C stands.

frame.reading: partial_red is exactly the direction the Cor-7.3 triple cannot reach: the triple fixes x, the frame needs it. That is Cor 7.3's ML argument, seen as linear algebra.

sections.verdict: The bracket structure yields no new coordinate route. The only commuting sub-algebra is the Cor-7.3 triple, whose invariants are C[x], and Lemma L1 rules x out as a coordinate. partial_red is precisely the direction that triple cannot reach.
